lines.en: I drag one foot forward.

lines.zh: 铁皮在我身上咔咔作响
lines.en: Iron plates clank on me.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩浆边走，不怕热
lines.en: I walk the lava's edge; heat doesn't bother me.
My steps are uneven, but they don't stop.

lines.zh: 黑烟从我关节里冒出来
lines.en: Black smoke leaks from my joints.
I lurch toward any sound.
Every step makes fire flicker.
I keep out of a ghast's line of sight.
Rust fills my footprints.
My knee joint catches halfway.
I push on, not watching my feet.

lines.zh: 铁靴在碎石上刮出声音
lines.en: Steel boots scrape the gravel.
I stand rigid where I am.
I groan low, without words.
The fire in my joints jumps once.
I lift my head; my neck clicks three times.
This body should have come apart long ago.
My lungs were replaced with iron long ago.
I clench a fist; the plates clash.
I remember I was once a person.

lines.zh: 我不记得那是多久以前
lines.en: I don't remember how long ago.
Lava light plays on my hide.
I turn my head, slowly.
There's living blood on you.

lines.zh: 我的手臂接的是金属管。
lines.en: A metal pipe replaces my arm.

lines.zh: 你站在远处，我算着距离
lines.en: You stand far off; I measure the distance.
I remember that look.
I raise a hand; plates scrape my helmet.
You'll end like the last one.
Argent energy hums in my tubing.
Back away. It won't help.
My machine leg clicks.
A plate has caved in.

lines.zh: 火星从我的关节里冒出来。
lines.en: Sparks spit from my joints.
Sparks spit from the crack.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的骨头在响
lines.en: I hear my own bones rattle.
I can't lift that arm now.
I feel no pain, only dullness.
This body is a little more broken.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，没有表情
lines.en: I look at the wound without expression.
The black smoke thickens.
I can still walk.
I don't eat anymore.
That's no use to me.
I remember the taste of meat.
I look at it and don't move.
I reach out and swat it away.
Argent energy is what I want.
My stomach is a furnace.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿早就不是牙了
lines.en: What I have aren't teeth anymore.
That smell is too faint.
Flesh is useless to me.
You hit my plating — loud.
I'm barely moved.
I turn slightly and give way.
Rust rubbed off on your sleeve.
That much force won't shift me.
The stone under me cracks.
You knocked my shoulder plate askew.
We pass each other close.
Bumping doesn't trouble me.
You'd best keep your distance.
In this state, it isn't fit.
I can't even look after myself.
This body is only a tool.
I can't recall what tenderness was.
Go on. Don't become me.

lines.zh: 活着的人还有别的事要做
lines.en: The living have other things to do.
Standing here is enough for me.
I don't need anyone with me.
This isn't a refusal.
I'm long past that time.
I bend; my joints creak.
I pinch it up with two fingers.
I look at it and toss it aside.
This could be a weapon.
I shove it into my breastplate.
Too heavy; it drags at me.
I count them and pocket them.
It cracked in my hand.
Even scrap gets hauled back.
I throw it to you.
I hear something living walk.
I raise my head and orient.
That's a Nether creature.
My fire burns brighter.
I take one step that way.
I know this ground.
Its scent gets into my shell.
I clench my fist.
It doesn't know I'm here.
I'll be loud when I move. Can't help it.
That's what I want.
I've locked onto it.
From now on, only it.
I pick up speed, slowly.
The fire in my plating surges.
I drag my iron leg toward you.
It retreats; I don't speed up.
My footsteps are the warning.
It ducks behind a rock.
I simply push the rock aside.
It's running now.
I chase slowly, but I don't stop.
My flames stretch behind me.
It stepped on something; it clinked.
I can smell its fear.
There are no branches in this path.
It has only one way left.
I raise my arm to bring it down.
Close enough.
Right here.
I take the last heavy step.
It has nowhere left to go.
I lift my fist high.
Down.
This ends it.
My iron fist dents the floor.
My iron fist breaks its bones.
I seize it and slam it down.
Fire bursts from my chest.
The heat drives it back.
I kick it away.
This one comes from the side.
My joints rattle through the swing.
It's not dead. I strike again.

lines.zh: 铁皮撞在一起，火星四溅
lines.en: Plate hits plate; sparks fly.
I pin it underfoot so it can't move.
I look down at it and feel nothing.
Blood is on my gauntlet.
Done. I straighten up.
The fire slowly dies down.
Where's the next one?
I drive my elbow and pin it to the wall.

lines.zh: 它的骨头在我手里断了
lines.en: Its bones break in my grip.
I push myself up by the lava.
Slag still clings to my plating.

lines.zh: 我记不清自己怎么来的
lines.en: I can't recall how I got here.
My joints turn for the first time, stiffly.

lines.zh: 我看见自己的手是铁的
lines.en: I see my hand is iron.

lines.zh: 下界的空气灌进我的壳
lines.en: Nether air fills my shell.
My fire lights on its own.
I try to stand and manage it.
Everything around is lava light.

lines.zh: 我记得有人把我改造了
lines.en: I remember someone rebuilt me.

lines.zh: 我发出一声长长的低吼
lines.en: I let out a long, low moan.
This body won't feel pain again.
I start walking.
I don't know where I'm going.
Fire burns hotter inside my shell.
I fall, and my plates come loose.
Water enters my shell; my fire is dying.
The blast rolls me over.
A round lodges in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这股力量拧着我的核心
lines.en: This force twists at my core.
My fire is failing. I need fuel.
Current floods my plating.

lines.zh: 我掉进黑里，铁片在飘散
lines.en: I fall into the dark, and my plates drift apart.
